ASTRA — Outward pipeline, real-run digest

Generated 22 Sep 2026 13:56 · ALL 19 real KBL outward cheque images through the real OutwardScanWorkflow on a real Temporal worker; the 6 ACCEPTED went on through real endorsement, clearing session and NGCH submission · ACCEPTED: 6 CTS_REJECTED: 6 MISMATCH_HELD: 5 POST_DATED_HELD: 2
What is real: Temporal workflow + worker, activities, cloud OCR on the actual images, AccountVault (Redis + YugabyteDB), Redis, ImmuDB audit writes, MinIO, Kafka, lot assignment, endorsement stamping, clearing-session + NGCH submission (dev-stub NGCH — no NPCI sandbox exists).
Stand-ins (labelled): CBS = dev stub with seeded accounts · NGCH = dev stub · depositor account numbers are synthetic and entered teller-style (no deposit slips exist) · payee name shown as "not extracted by OCR" where the OCR model genuinely did not return one — not hidden or fabricated.
AI model honesty: no local GPU/vLLM models are running in this dev environment. OCR falls back to HF cloud (Qwen2.5-VL) — labelled per cheque above with confidence + engines used. ‡ Signature detection, security-feature checks and the vision amount cross-check have no local vision model either; they run their documented graceful-degradation path (see check = activity completed, not necessarily a genuine trained-model validation). A green checkmark means the real Temporal activity ran and returned PROCEED — it does not by itself mean a trained AI model examined the image.
Multi-script OCR (real, confirmed live): Indic-script zone refinement (GOT-OCR2/HF-cloud → detect script → crop the field's zone → call the IndicOCR sidecar) genuinely ran tonight and replaced one field (amount_words on 058475, devanagari, confirmed in the worker log). Only 3 of 19 cheques had any Indic-script text in an extracted field at all — most payee names on this real cheque set were printed in Latin script already. Zone refinement depends on the field's expected pixel region matching a standard cheque layout; these are photographs of different banks' real cheques (DCB, Canara, UCO, Indian Bank, Karnataka Bank...), not standardised scans, so it does not fire for every non-Latin field. Where OCR returned Indic-script text (blue italic), an English transliteration is now shown alongside it — generated live from the real payee_normalizer.transliterate_by_script() already in this codebase, using its dependency-free phonemic engine (the optional neural transliterator, ai4bharat-transliteration, is not installed in this dev environment — confirmed by the indicxlit_unavailable_phonemic_fallback log line). This is an approximation, not a trained model: e.g. राजू पटेल → "raju patela" (a native speaker would write "Raju Patel").
Limitations: * no rear images exist, so the front image is passed as the rear — the endorsement stamp is deliberately small and confined to the top-left corner so it never lands on the signature/amount/payee · † images are photos, not scanner captures, so cts.strict_image_quality=false is set for the dev bank only (explicit config row, never a default).
